title: 恒隆拨备拖累利润：杭州新商场客流销售强劲，零售回暖能持续吗？
speaker: Adriel Chan

segments.en: Good half. Question mark, how did it live up to your expectations?
segments.zh: 上半年不错。但业绩是否符合您的预期？

segments.en: I think it was a good half. So the top line numbers are not great, but that's primarily because we had a provision, which is a non-cash provision, really reflecting the slower sales in China than we had expected.
segments.zh: 我认为上半年不错。营收数据不算亮眼，主要是因为计提了非现金拨备，反映了内地销售比预期缓慢。

segments.en: So that is one thing which is weighed on our profits, but if you look at the underlying leasing profit, you look at the foot traffic, you look at the sales of our malls, and actually it's pretty strong.
segments.zh: 这拖累了利润，但若看核心租赁利润、客流量和商场销售，其实相当强劲。

segments.en: So I feel cautiously optimistic. I think that it's met expectations, and of course we have our new mall online in Hangzhou, which is performed, I would say, outperformed my own expectations.
segments.zh: 所以我持谨慎乐观态度。业绩符合预期，而且杭州新商场已经开业，表现超出了我个人的预期。
